name: RRSOS PCC Base
description: Builds the shell of a base in the running game at the Prime template location: at planetfall, or on request. T0 is foundations, pods, crates with their labels (stocked with starter ore from their labels), a craft station and the anchor lamp; nothing that makes anything, no furniture, screens or Terminal. Once per save and only on an empty site. After that it only keeps buildings up to date: upgrade chains (upgrades.txt) swap a building for its next tier in place when it is unlocked. Also the power [ ON ] / [ OFF ] buttons on the Energy window.

commands.name: /undo
commands.help: take back what the base mod placed in this save
